{{Quote|T/I Eta, intercept SPC Derdmin. Remember, no prisoners!|Imperial officer|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
'''''Derdmin''''' was an [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to patrol [[XQ3 Platform]] [[AZ 77]].

At some point in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces from the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon B frigate]], [[Implacable (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Implacable'']], attacked the platform to lure the [[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|MC40a light cruiser]], [[Ardent (MC40a light cruiser)|''Ardent'']], into an ambush. The patrol craft was destroyed, along with the platform and its defenses of [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]].
